definitions.explanation: The tenth sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly December 22 to January 19. Also the constellation Capricornus. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs; often written with the kana やぎ{座|ざ}.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{山羊座|やぎざ}だ。
{山羊座|やぎざ}の{人|ひと}は{努力家|どりょくか}が{多|おお}いと{言|い}われる。
examples.english: Capricorn people are said to be hard workers.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}の{山羊座|やぎざ}は、{地道|じみち}な{努力|どりょく}が{実|みの}る{時期|じき}だそうだ。
examples.english: This month's horoscope says it's a time when steady effort will pay off for Capricorn.

notes:
The zodiac sign Capricorn, for people born from late December to mid-January. The kana spelling やぎ{座|ざ} is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山羊座|やぎざ}の{人|ひと}: a person born under Capricorn
- {山羊座|やぎざ}{生|う}まれ: born a Capricorn
- {山羊座|やぎざ}の{運勢|うんせい}: the Capricorn horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments ({星占|ほしうらな}い).
